text: Since the start of the game, I have observed several movements from Fjordal and Dunmar. Fjordal sent armies at bells 17, 18, 19, 20, 42, 44, 48, 53, and 66. These marches originated from (3,-2) and (3,-3). Dunmar sent armies at bells 30, 35, and 40, originating from (-1,-2). I have no grievances to address at this time.
